text:
ben: Hey @people-ops — heads-up: Olivia and Rita have overlapping parental leaves (both targeting July/Aug). Can we get a compact plan: what to file now, coverage options, and any payroll quirks for overlapping top-ups?

people-ops: Quick starter: 1) Employees submit Parental Leave Request ASAP. 2) Check FMLA/state entitlement (if applicable). 3) Enroll in company pay-topup before payroll cutoff for the first paid period (cutoff = 15th). 4) Collect birth/adoption docs within 30 days. Link to forms: https://hr.redwood.example/forms/parental-leave

payroll: Note: when two leaves overlap we run a combined-pay calculation to avoid overpayments vs state benefits (e.g., CA PFL). If top-up enrollment misses the payroll cutoff we can retro-adjust but pay will arrive later. Send tentative dates + latest paystub PDF.

olivia: Thanks — I can submit my request tonight. Tentative: July 12 start, 12 weeks.

rita: I
lso planning July 26 start, 10 weeks. I'll fill the form today.

people-ops: Coverage options (short bullets):
- Internal rotation: assign critical oncall + pair handoffs. Low cost, faster.
- Short contractor (6-8 weeks): good for sustained paging; needs procurement + SOW (~2 weeks min).
- Split model: contractor for oncall, team handles roadmap.

hiring-ops-bot: Temp hire flow: manager headcount note + role bullets + hourly cap. Typical lead time 8-12 business days for SOW + vendor onboarding when fast-tracked (mark ticket URGENT-TEMP).

ben: If contractor timeline is long, we'll prefer internal rotation. What does a minimal handoff runbook look like?

people-ops: Minimal runbook should include: deploy steps, common alerts & triage steps, key contacts, one-week escalation plan, and a short Loom demo for each task. Aim for two pairing sessions before leave.

rita: I'll draft the runbook and two Loom clips (deploy + pager triage) this week.

olivia: I can cover critical bugs in week 1 of Rita's leave if needed.

payroll: Also flag: benefits continuation during paid leave stays active. If either goes to unpaid status after top-up ends, we'd send COBRA notice. FSAs/commuter benefits require benefits@redwood.example to confirm mid-year changes.

people-ops: Quick sample rota we suggest:
```
Week -2 to 0: shallow shadowing + runbook PR
Week 1-2: pair handoff + contractor overlap (if hired)
Week 3+: contractor handles oncall, team owns long-term work
```

ben: Please open the hiring ops ticket and cc me. I'll decide on contractor vs rotation after I see lead time.

hiring-ops-bot: Ticket HR-TEMP-7812 created. Add hourly cap and preferred start date to move forward. Procurement looped in.

hr-bot: Attached checklist: Parental Leave form, Manager Handoff Template, Temp SOW template (https://hr.redwood.example/checklists/parental-temp). :white_check_mark:

ben: Thanks all — I'll post confirmed dates once the forms are in. Appreciated.
